title: Agent-X: Evaluating Deep Multimodal Reasoning in Vision-Centric Agentic Tasks
authors_zh: Tajamul Ashraf、Amal Saqib、Hanan Gani、Muhra AlMahri、Yuhao Li、Noor Ahsan、Umair Nawaz、Jean Lahoud、Hisham Cholakkal、Mubarak Shah、Philip H. S. Torr、Fahad Shahbaz Khan、Rao Muhammad Anwer、Salman Khan
paper_type_zh: 过程与轨迹监督数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要评测视觉智能体在真实多步任务中如何选择工具、组织过程并完成任务的研究者。
one_line: Agent-X provides 828 human-reviewed multimodal tool-use tasks with stepwise traces and judges that score local decisions, full-chain reasoning, and final success separately.
Agent-X 提供 828 个经人工复核的多模态工具使用任务，以逐步轨迹分别评测局部决策、整链推理和最终成功。
why: It exposes agent failures that final task success alone cannot localize, especially where vision context and tool choice interact.
inclusion_reason: The official release provides reusable step- or trace-level supervision for training or evaluating reasoning verifiers and reward models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A visual agent must not only interpret single images, multiple images, or video, but also plan information needs, invoke tools, and integrate returned evidence. A wrong final answer cannot reveal whether perception, tool choice, or long-horizon reasoning failed, and traditional VQA benchmarks lack replayable tool traces.

Agent-X builds 828 real multimodal agent tasks, records observations, plans, tool calls, and intermediate results, and evaluates single-step tool use, complete reasoning chains, and final outcomes separately.

视觉 Agent 不仅要识别单张或多张图像，还要规划信息需求、调用工具并整合返回结果；最终答案错误无法说明是感知、工具选择还是长程推理失败。传统 VQA 基准也没有可重放工具轨迹。

Agent-X 构建 828 项真实多模态 Agent 任务，记录观察、计划、工具调用和中间结果，并从单步工具使用、完整推理链和最终结果三层评测。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Agent-X contains 828 tasks combining images, multiple images, video, and text, together with human-reviewed tool trajectories. Each record preserves input modalities, task goals, stepwise observations and actions, tool results, failure locations, and final answers. Three metric levels evaluate tool actions, reasoning chains, and task completion. It is a process benchmark for vision-centric agents rather than ordinary multimodal QA data.
Agent-X 包含 828 项图像、多图、视频与文本结合的任务及人工复核工具轨迹。每条记录保存输入模态、任务目标、逐步观察与动作、工具结果、失败位置和最终答案；三层指标分别衡量工具动作、推理链及任务完成。它是视觉中心 Agent 的过程评测集，不是普通多模态问答数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build tasks: Collect image, multi-image, video, and text inputs and design tasks that require tool use.
  1. Execute trajectories: Have agents plan, select tools, and record observations, actions, and intermediate results at each step.
  1. Human review: Review tool calls, reasoning chains, and final answers, labeling failure locations and causes.
  1. Layered evaluation: Compute step-, chain-, and outcome-level metrics separately; reproduction must fix tool versions, environments, and scoring rules.

1. 构建任务：收集图像、多图、视频和文本输入，设计必须调用工具的任务。
  1. 执行轨迹：让 Agent 规划、选择工具并记录每一步观察、动作和中间结果。
  1. 人工复核：检查工具调用、推理链和最终答案，标注失败位置与原因。
  1. 分层评测：分别计算步骤、链路和结果指标；复现需固定工具版本、任务环境和判分规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Unified evaluation of GPT, Gemini, and Qwen systems shows that individual tool actions can be correct while complete-chain success remains below 50%. Errors accumulate through missing visual evidence, incorrect tool order, and poor cross-step integration. The three-level scoring separates agents that can use tools but cannot finish the task from those that answer correctly by chance. The conclusion depends on stable tool versions and task environments.
对 GPT、Gemini 和 Qwen 系统的统一测试显示，单个工具动作可能正确，但完整推理链成功率仍低于 50%；错误会在视觉证据遗漏、工具调用顺序和跨步骤信息整合中累积。三层评分因此能区分“工具会用但任务做不完”和“答案偶然正确”。结论受工具版本和任务环境稳定性约束。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing multimodal agent benchmarks often score only the final answer or whether a tool call succeeds. Agent-X preserves visual evidence, plans, tool outputs, and failure locations and evaluates steps, chains, and outcomes separately. The novelty is an auditable trajectory combining deep multimodal reasoning with tool execution rather than another VQA question set.
现有多模态 Agent 基准通常只评最终答案或工具调用是否成功，Agent-X 同时保存视觉证据、计划、工具结果和失败位置，并分别评价步骤、链和结果。新意在把深度多模态推理与工具执行放入同一可审计轨迹，而不是增加一个新的 VQA 题库。

title: Limitations
局限
html: First, 828 tasks cannot cover all visual applications, video lengths, and tool combinations, producing high variance in narrow categories. Second, tool or web updates can make trajectories unreplayable. Third, human failure locations in long chains may be causally ambiguous; evaluation should preserve environment snapshots and distinguish root causes from downstream symptoms.
第一，828 项任务不足以覆盖所有视觉软件、视频长度和工具组合，细分类结果方差较大。第二，工具或网页随时间更新会使轨迹不可重放。第三，人工失败位置对长链可能存在因果歧义；评测时应保存环境快照，并区分根因与后续症状。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Agent-X can compare visual agents on perception, tool choice, and long-horizon integration and can serve as a hidden test set for trajectory critics. Reproduction should freeze tools, web content, and timestamps and report single-step, complete-chain, and final-task success. For systems without tools or with only static single images, an ordinary multimodal process benchmark is more appropriate.
可用 Agent-X 比较视觉 Agent 在感知、工具选择和长程整合上的分项能力，也可作为轨迹级 critic 的隐藏测试集。复现时应冻结工具、网页和时间戳，并报告单步成功、完整链成功和最终任务成功。若系统不调用工具或输入仅为静态单图，使用普通多模态过程基准更合适。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: Jointly evaluates visual understanding, long-horizon reasoning, and tool use.
  1. Method handle: Visual-task construction, tool-trajectory logging, human review, and three-level scoring.
  1. Data handle: Agent-X contains 828 tasks with human-reviewed trajectories.
  1. Evidence anchor: The strongest systems remain below 50% full-chain success.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for vision agents; first freeze tools, environments, and timestamps.

1. 一句话定位：联合评测视觉理解、长程推理和工具使用。
  1. 方法抓手：视觉任务构建、工具轨迹记录、人工复核和三层评分。
  1. 数据抓手：Agent-X 含 828 项任务和人工复核轨迹。
  1. 证据锚点：最强系统完整链成功率仍低于 50%。
  1. 复用决定：适合视觉 Agent；先固定工具、环境和时间戳。
